mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/docx-comments.test.ts:all existing comment Gherkin cases assert saved outcomes
outcomes: The wrapper reports no failures and 14 passed existing-comment cases. Pinned bindings compare all three comment records, resolve receipt, root done and unchanged reply state/link after byte reopen, single changed extension part, member restoration after reopening and unchanged archives on no-op/refusal.
gaps: Only two aggregate assertions occur here; semantic checks are delegated. save/reopen wording means byte reopen, not a path save. The final reopen restores every member payload, not necessarily original ZIP bytes. Refusal checks require OoxmlError class, not a specific code. Nine Python-profile scenarios are filtered out, not executed; no comment authoring, filtering or reply-to-root mutation policy is claimed.

Existing-extension-only bounded source mapping; direct/deferred assertion separation and loop review flags retained, runtime leaves unknown. No new execution, Python-profile or rendered-comment credit.
